messages:
Maria: FYI customer requested a verifiable timeline + proof of which KMS key and which principal performed decrypts in the 2026-03-18 incident window. They also want any RBAC changes correlated.
Ajay: Which logs do they expect? platform audit events vs KMS provider logs vs k8s?
Maria: Platform audit is primary. KMS provider logs as supporting evidence. Window: 2026-03-18T02:00Z - 2026-03-18T03:00Z. They want signed export.
Kevin: Quick note: platform currently records kms.decrypt with fields: timestamp, principal_id, principal_email, action, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, correlation_id, metadata (json). We do NOT reliably store kms_key_id or key_version in metadata.
Sara: Retention is 90 days; this event is inside that window so raw events exist in S3. Backfilling key metadata may require joining provider logs.
Ajay: I ran a quick query to look for matching events:
```
SELECT timestamp, principal_email, action, resource_id, metadata->>'kms_key_id' AS kms_key, request_id, correlation_id
FROM platform_audit
WHERE action IN ('kms.decrypt','rbac.update')
  AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-18 02:00:00' AND '2026-03-18 03:00:00'
ORDER BY timestamp;
```
Kevin: Results: two kms.decrypt events with same request_id but metadata.kms_key_id is NULL. There is an rbac.update at 02:15 by user@acme.com changing role binding.
Maria: Timeline looks like: rbac.update @ 02:15 -> kms.decrypt @ 02:17. Customer says their admin didn’t perform the RBAC change.
Ajay: To produce customer-facing artifact we need: raw JSON event lines, a CSV timeline, and a signed hash (sha256) + chain-of-custody note. Any redaction rules?
Maria: Minimal redaction only (mask unrelated PII). Legal wants a signed statement listing systems the logs went through.
Sara: Proposed schema additions for audit v2 (optional fields so we can backfill): kms_key_id, kms_key_version, auth_context.auth_method, pre_snapshot, post_snapshot (for rbac.update diffs). Also confirm request_context.remote_ip and auth_context.mfa are present — we already log those.
Kevin: Backfill plan: 1) join platform_audit to kms-provider-audit by request_id where available; 2) if request_id missing, try correlation_id; 3) fall back to time-window + resource_id match and heuristics; 4) write derived rows to audit_enriched_v2 with new fields.
Ajay: Example enrichment query I’ll run (pseudo):
```
INSERT INTO audit_enriched_v2
SELECT p.*, k.key_id AS kms_key_id, k.key_version, p.metadata || jsonb_build_object('kms_key_id', k.key_id) AS metadata
FROM platform_audit p
LEFT JOIN kms_audit k ON p.request_id = k.request_id
WHERE p.timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-18 02:00' AND '2026-03-18 03:00' AND p.action IN ('kms.decrypt','rbac.update');
```
Kevin: If kms_audit lacks request_id we can match on correlation_id. Edge cases: provider may only log key ARN; normalize to our key ids.
Ajay: ops-incident-bot, please queue export job for the window and attach raw S3 paths. @ops-incident-bot
ops-incident-bot: export job queued: job_id=exp-20260318-77, ETA ~7m.
Kevin: Security note: sign the exported tarball with support signing key and include sha256. Use detached signature.
Ajay: I'll produce CSV + raw JSON lines and run:
```
sha256sum export.csv > export.csv.sha256
openssl dgst -sha256 -sign /keys/support-signing.pem -out export.csv.sig export.csv
```
Sara: I'll prepare retention and redaction notes and update the incident playbook.
Maria: Approving the export for customer. Include an explicit statement: we correlated RBAC change -> decrypt, with supporting request_id and remote IP.
Ajay: Quick question: how do we prove the principal? We have principal_email and auth_method. For service tokens we only have service_id; for user logins we can include mfa flag and device IP.
Kevin: We log request_context.remote_ip and auth_context.mfa. Include those in the export. Also include auth_context.auth_method in schema v2.
Sara: I filed SEC ticket SEC-4872 to track schema changes, backfill, and export artefact.
Maria: Postmortem action: add kms_key_id to realtime enrichment pipeline so future decrypt events always include key id.
ops-incident-bot: export job completed: job_id=exp-20260318-77, s3://redwood-incident-exports/exp-20260318-77/export.csv.gz.md5
Ajay: Export uploaded and signed. Sending S3 link + signature to customer via secure DM.
Maria: Customer confirmed receipt and said the evidence is sufficient for now. We'll follow up in 24h with schema PR timeline and delivery ETA. :thumbsup:
